hook: Your MacBook trackpad can talk, with no speaker

beats.say: A MacBook trackpad has no speaker, just a small haptic motor that taps the glass so you feel a click.
The open-source tool NO SPEAKER drives that motor up to 4,000 times a second, fast enough to make audible sound, and turns it into a voice that talks, sings and raps.
It is one Swift program for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, signed and notarized, and it still talks with the Mac muted.
